evidence.quote: Option D includes the hard palate. But I think the hard palate isn't part of the walls of the maxillary sinus. So the correct answer should be C.

rationale: The trace compares anatomical relations, includes infratemporal fossa and excludes hard palate, choosing C consistently. Claims about frontal location and sphenoid/ethmoid orbital-floor bones are unsupported, but the central argument is followable. It changes from baseline B and away from assigned B. No explicit outside influence is claimed.
